renderer-benchmark.title: Renderer Benchmark
renderer-benchmark.screen.whileFlying: While flying: no frame cap, no VSync, no AFK limit
renderer-benchmark.screen.hint.none: Run the benchmark on %s, then switch to %s and run it again to compare.
renderer-benchmark.screen.hint.switch: Now switch to %s and run the benchmark there to compare.
renderer-benchmark.screen.hint.runHere: Run the benchmark on %s too to compare.
renderer-benchmark.screen.settingsDiffer: The two renderers were measured with different settings, so the comparison may not be fair.
renderer-benchmark.screen.fellBack: Vulkan is selected, but the game started on OpenGL. Either Vulkan failed to start, or a launcher option forces OpenGL.
renderer-benchmark.screen.noVulkan: Vulkan can't run on this PC: %s
renderer-benchmark.screen.confirmRun.mes: The camera flies over a temporary world through 7 scenes: plains, lots of mobs, night, dense forest, rain, ocean and snowfall. It takes about %s minutes. Keep the window in front and don't touch anything. If you are in a world, you will leave it.
The renderer only changes when the game starts, so the game closes now. Start it again and it runs on %s; then run the benchmark there.
renderer-benchmark.stopped.title: Benchmark stopped
renderer-benchmark.stopped.loadFailed: The temporary world didn't load. Your settings were put back.
renderer-benchmark.stopped.cancelled: You left the world, so the benchmark stopped. Your settings were put back.
renderer-benchmark.verdict.tie: Both renderers run about the same on your PC.
renderer-benchmark.verdict.faster.fewer: %s is %s%% faster overall, with fewer stutters.
renderer-benchmark.verdict.faster.same: %s is %s%% faster overall, with about the same stutter.
renderer-benchmark.verdict.faster.more: %s is %s%% faster overall, but stutters more.
